raw_text: AltNews investigation: The viral claim of Indian Army deploying robot soldiers on the LoC originates from 'Fauji Times Parody,' a well-known satire page. The article was published on April 1, 2024, and contains obvious humorous elements including references to chai dispensers and instant RTI filing. Multiple social media accounts stripped the satire disclaimer and reshared it as genuine defence news. No credible defence publication has reported any such deployment.
clean_text: AltNews debunks viral robot soldier claim. Originates from Fauji Times Parody, published April 1. Satire disclaimer stripped by resharing accounts. No credible source confirms deployment.
